title: Wordmark cap
slide_intent: Reduce a signature to an appropriate scale so a small object remains recognizable without overwhelming its form.
strategic_value: A small bright wordmark can connect Sweetgreen apparel to its vivid digital accents.
demonstration: A dark green cap hangs on a cactus with a small yellow-green sweetgreen wordmark on its front.
practical_value: Compare the visibility of a compact signature against dark fabric and a textured environment.

content_islands.name: Cap
content_islands.spec: Keep the small wordmark on the front panel of the dark cap.

content_islands.name: Cactus setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the surrounding vertical cactus forms and sunlit background.

reference_purposes.Application: The wordmark is applied at small scale to a cap.
reference_purposes.Expression: A bright signature contrasts with the dark green fabric.
